snippet.title: Performance Review: Survivor - Out Now on Steam
snippet.description:
Performance Review: Survivor is out now on Steam!

AI is taking your job. Fight back.

Performance Review: Survivor is a satirical bullet heaven roguelite. Your weapons are office supplies, the horde is your coworkers, and your manager is an AI that's quietly deciding whether you're still needed. Survive 30 years to reach retirement.

In the demo:
• Auto-fire staplers, business card shurikens, reply-all storms and lawsuits at hordes of coworkers
• Stack upgrades and evolve your weapons into a screen-clearing build
• Answer the AI Manager's calls mid-fight and take the Promotion Packet
• Get fired, then fight your way back through the job portal, the interview and the salary elevator
• Full controller support

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4691400/Performance_Review_Survivor/
